scope: Close SOL-009 D1/D2 against corrected v2 design and independently audit the chief policy kernel using synthetic-only evidence.

parameters.release_requires: Ready now: accepted negative SOL-009 evidence and successful SOL-010 are recorded; this task itself must approve corrected design AND kernel before production integration.

acceptance_checks: Validate immutable task/base, exact source/blob hashes, allowed paths, actual independent Python 3.12 execution; no competition outcomes.

Close SOL-009 D1 using eligible-first, maximum-anchored ties, final strict hurdle and priority; independently check near-tie/ineligible-active/nontransitive-chain examples. Close D2 with paired median/folds versus marginal tails, BOTH adaptive controls and context-fails eligibility.
Independently recompute gamma=4 CE, exact inflation, 15:n mixture n=0..5, buffered versus actual fee and rational initial holdings without production expected-value helpers.

Challenge all five modes, zero/primary/doubled fees, strict boundaries, active-state update on any executed target request even when T<=1e-10, positive tiny fees, first deployment/null, persistent year-1 deferred flag and reason semantics.

Probe year-6 adaptive restriction, exact prefix/no-current-outcome timing, future perturbations, state reuse/mutation, observer/engine fee agreement, post-fee inflation drawdown, latch and exact holdings while pending.

Read-only --check must bind source and saved artifacts, reproduce independent numerical evidence at proper tolerances and reject corruption; preserve failed trials. Source checks must use pinned Git objects, not require current main checkout to stay unchanged.

Return separate corrected_design_verdict and code_verdict (approve/changes_required); a supported negative result is valid review evidence. No production implementation, new parameter search, final access, installs, watchers or task dispatch.
instructions:
Read AGENTS.md and the locked problem/accounting contracts. SOL-009 is accepted as negative independent design evidence, NOT design approval. SOL-011 was never executed and is cancelled because its unchanged-design release condition failed. This is its corrected immutable successor plus narrow D1/D2 closure, not a repeat of accepted review work. Review exactly the sources in parameters.source_sha256 at this base, with current v2 taking precedence over historical prototype prose. No current main merge or silent redesign.

First independently close the two concrete SOL-009 blockers and inspect the L1-L8 resolutions in POLICY_CORRECTION_V2.md. Use synthetic comparisons to distinguish median paired gain from difference of medians, and differences of marginal p10/p90 from quantiles of paired differences. Verify explicit fixed comparators [balanced_context, balanced_cost], adaptive eligibility even if context fails provided BOTH direct gates pass, inclusive numeric thresholds versus strictly positive folds, and separation of primary choice from doubled-fee robustness. No production selection module exists yet; this portion is design closure only. Confirm own-horizon personalized risk AND purchasing-power rescreen with referral/no fallback, full eligibility sets and unchanged normative numeric parameters.

Then build an independent scalar/rational oracle in audit/SOL-013/verify.py and audit the actual corrected policy kernel. The chief's 17 tests are provisional, not independent evidence. Check inverse-cube utility, exact real factors, 15:n mixture, all targets, strict S>keep+1e-12, ties to eligible maximum and active/defensive/central/growth priority. In prior=(1.10,1.02,1), all-bills-to-thirds, k=.0025 derive rational initial fee, buffered score and actual wealth independently. Probe finite extreme inputs and invalid final observations; distinguish invalid failed runs from completed suspended paths.

Challenge sequential state reuse, wrong scenario/history, no current observations, prefix horizon equality and future perturbations. Adaptive alternatives first appear at year 6. Independently reconstruct CPI, holdings and post-fee/year-end peaks. Include fee-induced loss then same-year recovery, pure-inflation loss, latch persistence, and zero-fee exact component-dollar keep while pending. The reporting epsilon now ONLY controls is_trade; an accepted target-change request updates active state and executed_target_change even below 1e-10, with its exact fee still charged. Find/probe the tiny-transfer corner directly; an explicitly labelled injected decision fixture is acceptable for isolated transition mechanics, but must not be mistaken for evidence the real score gate produced it. Verify first_deployment_year/null and persistent year-1 initial_allocation_deferred separately. A first deployment after year 1 has reason initial_allocation; later requests use rebalance/target_change. No existing accepted baseline semantics change.

Write review.md, findings.json and verification.json with precise reviewed source, expected and observed numerical facts, separate corrected_design_verdict/code_verdict, blockers/limitations and exact fixes. Initial evidence creation refuses overwrite; preserve every meaningful failure with diagnosis. Portable --check recomputes facts and verifies source/artifact hashes read-only, compares numerical tolerances and exits nonzero on deliberately corrupted scratch evidence. Use pinned Git blobs and verify code bytes imported match pinned source (document LF normalization if needed); never demand that HEAD stay a worker commit. A negative verdict itself is not evidence failure. Can use accepted SOL-009 mathematical evidence as context, but actual kernel checks must be independent of production expected-value helpers.

This kernel still has no production loader, output writer, profile selector or final API. Do not implement those or demand this narrow module certify them. Scope is audit/SOL-013 only plus ignored scratch. Do not read original/development/final CSV outcomes, rerun HY3-003, install anything, edit source/tasks/runtime/private member files, start or restart watchers, publish tasks or run actual strategy outcomes. CPU-only within 25 minutes; keep model output concise. The runner handles receipt and branch push; chief alone accepts.
